subject.title: fix(elevenlabs): route TTS and voice egress through the trusted env proxy

question: Should ElevenLabs voice listing and TTS adopt the existing trusted environment-proxy mode, accepting proxy-side hostname resolution when an eligible proxy is configured?
rationale: The code uses an established SDK preset and the submitted evidence demonstrates the intended proxy-required behavior, but the egress/DNS security boundary is a maintainer policy choice that cannot be inferred solely from a contributor-run fixture.

options.title: Accept the established proxy contract
options.body: Confirm that ElevenLabs should match sibling provider discovery calls by using trusted environment-proxy mode for these three allowlisted requests.

options.title: Keep direct-only egress
options.body: Reject the proxy-mode expansion if ElevenLabs voice traffic must retain client-side pinned-DNS resolution even on proxy-required networks.

recommendation.title: Accept the established proxy contract
recommendation.body: Confirm that ElevenLabs should match sibling provider discovery calls by using trusted environment-proxy mode for these three allowlisted requests.
